biography: Simone Riccitelli, born under the Tuscan sun, didn't discover racing through a silver spoon. His father, a mechanic in a small village, instilled in him a love for engines and speed from a young age. Instead of go-karts, Simone cut his teeth rebuilding scooters, learning the intricacies of mechanics. His first taste of competitive racing came at 22, entering local hill climbs in a battered Fiat Cinquecento, surprising everyone with his raw talent and fearless driving. A chance encounter with a Ligier team scout at a regional event led to a test drive and, eventually, a seat in the Ligier JS2 R series. While flashes of brilliance have punctuated his career, consistency has been his Achilles' heel, a trait that has kept him from ascending to higher echelons of motorsport. Now at 32, Simone feels this is his time to prove his mettle and cement his legacy. He is determined to win races and prove his doubters wrong.
drivingStyle: Riccitelli's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He's known for his aggressive entries into corners, often pushing the limits of grip and flirting with disaster. While this approach can lead to spectacular overtakes and blistering lap times, it also results in costly mistakes and inconsistent results. He is not particularly known for his tire management, often sacrificing long-term pace for short bursts of speed. His pressure handling is also inconsistent, sometimes faltering under pressure, other times performing his best when the stakes are highest.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision at Imola in 2021, where Bellini accused Riccitelli of deliberately taking him out of the race.

rivalries.name: Alessia Russo
rivalries.reason: A rivalry sparked by Riccitelli's dismissive comments about female drivers early in his career, which Russo has used as fuel to consistently outperform him on track.

rivalries.name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
rivalries.reason: A battle of egos and driving styles. Dubois prioritizes consistency, while Riccitelli is more focused on pushing the limits, which often leads to on-track clashes.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky blue socks, regardless of weather.
Listens to opera music at full blast right before the race to 'find his focus'.
Refuses to eat pasta carbonara on race weekends, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe. It's about dancing on the edge of control and daring to push further than anyone else."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2022 Mugello Ligier JS2 R Challenge in front of his home crowd, after starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying incident.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2021 Imola race, costing him a potential championship victory.
